No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Hilary Duff Announces New Christmas EP ‘Holiday Things’ by Bukola Ogunsina 10 seconds ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram Hilary Duff is returning to Christmas music with a new EP, Holiday Things, scheduled for release on Friday, October 23.
The project features three original songs: All You Want for Christmas Is Me, I Want (A Few Small Things) and I Guess It’s Christmas. The first title playfully echoes Mariah Carey’s festive classic All I Want for Christmas Is You.
Duff has also recorded a version of Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas and revisited Wham!’s Last Christmas, which she previously covered for her 2003 holiday album, Santa Claus Lane.
Announcing the release on Instagram, the singer wrote: “I guess Christmas came early … Holiday Things is yours this Friday 10.23.”
The EP follows a significant return to music for Duff, whose first album in 10 years, Luck … or Something, debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200.
The release has also coincided with her ongoing Lucky Me arena tour. Duff recently added more performances to the schedule, extending the tour through November 2027.
